body:
Just wanted to post this. Everyone is saying how shit phentermine is, its no good for recreation. The reason for this people is simple, the dosage is not high enough. If one likes amphetamines, 400 mg is the dose. 5 x 40mg initially, as soon as one starts feeling it take another 5x 40mg. 400 mg all up. Not much different to meth. No crappy feelings, one needs to rise above those, come down the same. It just takes longer, doesn't kick in fully for 2 to 3 hours, just take it earlier. I have a bit of a tolerance so might not be for everyone.
